ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for Gies College of Business students that are studying abroad only until Monday, May 18, 2020. At approximately 10:00a.m. on that date, this section will open to all of campus with an enrollment limit to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this required course. Gies College of Business students on campus MUST register for the in-class option. Please find information about the online course here: http://publish.illinois.edu/onlinestudentorientation/.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Gies College of Business. Not intended for Nondegree major(s) or minor(s).
